_title: dossiq: marketplace without a registry (built-in packages)
_note: What you see: the Marketplace without a configured registry: the notice that nothing was fetched from outside (outcome not configured), the built-in packages as cards (a package is a case type with statuses, flows and templates, decision 182), installed or ready to install, and the registry status on the right. Anyone can search; only an administrator installs.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: de Marktplaats zonder ingestelde registry: de melding dat er niets van buiten is opgehaald (uitkomst niet geconfigureerd), de meegeleverde pakketten als kaarten (een pakket is een zaaktype met statussen, flows en sjablonen, besluit 182), geïnstalleerd of te installeren, en rechts de registrystatus. Zoeken mag iedere medewerker, installeren alleen een beheerder.
dossiq: marktplaats zonder registry (mee: dossiq: marketplace without a registry (built-in packages)
U ziet de pakketten die met dossiq zijn: You see the packages that ship with dossiq; nothing was fetched from outside. Set up a registry under Advanced to search for and install packages from other municipalities.
Een pakket is een zaaktype met zijn stat: A package is a case type with its statuses, flows and templates; the code stays the same
Zaaktype met 5 statussen, ontvangstbeves: Case type with 5 statuses, acknowledgement of receipt, deadline monitoring and 4 document templates.
Zaaktype met hoorzitting, adviescommissi: Case type with hearing, advisory committee, 6-week term and the decision on the objection.
Zaaktype met locatie, foto, doorzetten n: Case type with location, photo, forwarding to the field service and feedback to the resident.
Zaaktype met vooroverleg, toetsing, besc: Case type with pre-consultation, assessment, decision and publication; map layer for the parcel.
Zaaktype met beoordeling, verlening, voo: Case type with assessment, award, advance and final determination; flow for the payment.
Zaaktype met klachtbehandelaar, gesprek,: Case type with complaints officer, conversation, settlement and the report to the ombudsman.
Zoeken kan iedere medewerker; installere: Any employee can search; only an administrator can install and set up the registry.
Een pakket komt als nieuw zaaktype in uw: A package arrives as a new case type in your own configuration, next to what you already have. Only configuration is taken over: case types, statuses, roles, attributes, templates and flows. Cases or tasks in a package are refused and reported.
